decision: Add the llm_secret_handle lifecycle as two new isolated files plus one pure validator, editing no frozen file and not grants.ts. (1) src/core/secret-handle-validator.ts: a logic-only (IO-free) module exporting validateSecretHandleShape(value):SecretHandleVerdict (RL-3 not-a-raw-key heuristics — too_short<8, vendor_key_prefix sk-/sk-proj-/xai-/AIza, bare_hex_token ^[0-9a-fA-F]{32,}$, jwt_shape eyJ…three-segment), redactHandle(value) for status, and the SecretResolverPort interface that T-0039's resolveSecret port is structurally compatible with. (2) src/http/secret-handle.ts: registerSecretHandleRoutes(router,pool) with POST/PUT/DELETE/GET on /api/agents/:agentId/secret-handle(/status); each op authenticated via extractActor, authorized by reusing loadAdminContext + a holdsAgentMgmtUpdate predicate requiring a covering confirmed/in-window/delegable mgmt_object:agent/update grant (no new authority logic, scoped-admin.ts untouched), executed under the grants.ts withTenantTx SET-LOCAL+FORCE-RLS pattern (helper duplicated by the codebase's own write-path precedent), and audited through the canonical appendAuditEventInput sink with an AuditEventInput whose payload and every field never carries the handle value. Handle stored as-is after the shape guard; platform never decodes/resolves/calls an LLM (the resolveSecret resolution is the injected port consumed by T-0039 and implemented at Stage-2/T-0045). No new table, no migration (column from 032; no index), migration 033 stays unallocated.

rejected_alternatives.option: Append the lifecycle into grants.ts and reuse its withTenantTx/appendAuditEventInput directly.
rejected_alternatives.why_not: grants.ts structure is asserted by grant-editor-isolation.sh; adding routes/helpers churns a frozen surface for no gain and couples agent-card custody to the grant editor. A separate module mirrors the T-0039 grant-propose.ts precedent.

rejected_alternatives.option: Export withTenantTx from grants.ts and import it.
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Promotes a private helper to a public-surface export = new compatibility contract + frozen-file edit. The ~20-line helper is duplicated instead, per the codebase's own 'write-path needs own transaction' precedent.

rejected_alternatives.option: Programmatic-only API (no HTTP), called only by T-0042.
rejected_alternatives.why_not: The status read (FR-4) and the management-UI seam need an HTTP surface; T-0042's hire flow is HTTP. One thin HTTP surface (logic in the pure validator) avoids a later second adapter.

rejected_alternatives.option: Encrypt or hash the handle at rest.
rejected_alternatives.why_not: The handle is an opaque reference, not a secret (the secret lives client-side). Encrypting a non-secret adds key-management + a crypto dep for zero threat reduction; the RL-3 posture is enforced by the shape guard, not encryption.

rejected_alternatives.option: Enforce not-a-raw-key via a DB CHECK constraint or trigger.
rejected_alternatives.why_not: The heuristic is evolving policy; DDL makes it un-versioned and hard to test, and 032's DDL is deliberately narrow. Validation belongs in the pure TS validator. Preserves NF-5 (no migration).
No query filters/joins on the handle value (lookups are by PK (tenant_id, employee_id)); an index buys nothing and would index a sensitive-shaped column. 033 stays unallocated.

rejected_alternatives.option: Return the full handle (or full prefix) in the status response.
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Violates NF-1 categorically. redactHandle (scheme prefix / first-8 + ellipsis) gives operator confidence without leaking the value (FR-4).

contracts: src/core/secret-handle-validator.ts (NEW, pure/IO-free): export function validateSecretHandleShape(value: string): SecretHandleVerdict — reject order: too_short(<8) -> vendor_key_prefix(sk-|sk-proj-|xai-|AIza) -> bare_hex_token(^[0-9a-fA-F]{32,}$) -> jwt_shape(/^eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]*$/); a passing value is stored AS-IS (safeguard, not a full parser).
src/core/secret-handle-validator.ts: export function redactHandle(value: string): string — scheme prefix or first-8 + ellipsis; NEVER returns the full value; used only by the status endpoint.

src/core/secret-handle-validator.ts: export type SecretHandleVerdict = { ok: true } | { ok: false; reason: SecretHandleRejectReason }; export type SecretHandleRejectReason = 'too_short'|'vendor_key_prefix'|'bare_hex_token'|'jwt_shape'.

src/core/secret-handle-validator.ts: export interface SecretResolverPort { resolveSecret(handle: string, ctx: { tenantId: string }): Promise<string> } — custody port type T-0025 owns; T-0039 resolveSecret is structurally compatible; impl is Stage-2/T-0045 (T-0025 declares, never invokes).
src/http/secret-handle.ts (NEW): export function registerSecretHandleRoutes(router: Router, pool: pg.Pool): void.

POST   /api/agents/:agentId/secret-handle        body { handle_value: string } -> 200 { ok: true } | 400 INVALID_HANDLE(reason code) | 401 | 403 ADMIN_GATE_REJECTED | 404 AGENT_NOT_FOUND. Response NEVER echoes handle_value (NF-1).
PUT    /api/agents/:agentId/secret-handle        body { handle_value: string } -> rotate; same checks; atomic UPDATE under withTenantTx (AC-7); no value echoed.
DELETE /api/agents/:agentId/secret-handle        -> revoke; sets llm_secret_handle = NULL; same auth gate; 200 { ok: true }.
GET    /api/agents/:agentId/secret-handle/status -> 200 { bound: boolean, summary?: string } where summary = redactHandle(value); full value NEVER in response (FR-4/AC-9).

Per-op gate predicate holdsAgentMgmtUpdate(admin: AdminContext, agentOrgScope: ScopeElement): boolean = admin.isGenesisOwner || admin.adminGrants.some(g => g.resourceType==='mgmt_object:agent' && g.operation==='update' && g.delegable && isNarrowerOrEqual(agentOrgScope, g.scope, SEED_ORACLE)). Composes existing exports; scoped-admin.ts byte-unchanged (NF-6).

Persistence: UPDATE choros.agent_card SET llm_secret_handle = $2, updated_at = $3 WHERE tenant_id = current_setting('choros.tenant_id')::uuid AND employee_id = $1 RETURNING employee_id; rowCount=0 -> 404 (cross-tenant = 0 rows via FORCE RLS, AC-10). UPDATE + appendAuditEventInput in ONE withTenantTx (atomic).

Reused existing exports (compatibility contracts, T-0025 is a new importer of each, none renamed/removed): loadAdminContext (src/db/org.ts), isNarrowerOrEqual (src/core/scoped-admin.ts), AuditEventInput (src/core/audit-grant-encoder.ts), makePgAuditWriter/appendAuditEvent (src/db/audit-writer.ts), HttpError/readJsonBody/Router/extractActor-pattern (src/http).
